body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> iStation(representative Chae Jong-won) introduced world's first 3D Tablet 'Z3D' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
3D Tablet 'Z3D' realized glass type of 3D stereopsis and has been attracting huge expectation since the launching in Korea last August.

It features 7-inch electrostatic 3D panel and Android OS optimized for mobile internet. It supports Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and FM radio etc. It has strong multimedia functionality realizing super high-definition full HD video of 1080p and is portable because it's slim as 13.8mm thickness.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
